name: Craftsman's Writ: Blue Overalls

angles.text: Tailors stitch durable garments like blue overalls, making your needle and cloth essential for fulfilling this customer's order.

aliases: what is craftsman writ blue overalls
faq.answer: The faded writ requests a single pair of blue overalls, along with details on payment and where to deliver the finished clothing.
faq.q: What does this writ ask for?

faq.answer: Yes. Note text at the bottom marks the document as transferable, so any artisan holding the writ can supply the goods and collect the coin.
faq.q: Can another crafter fulfill this order?

faq.answer: The parchment notes a specific delivery location marked on your map where the customer waits to receive the clothing.
faq.q: Where do you deliver the finished overalls?

sections.body: A faded parchment orders a pair of blue overalls, detailing a customer's payment and delivery spot. You carry the transferable writ to the marked destination to hand over the tailored work and claim the transaction fee.
sections.title: A Tailored Order

summary: A customer has placed an order for a pair of blue overalls on a faded writ. You carry the transferable work order to the marked delivery location to hand over the garment and collect your payment.
attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Blue Overalls
